29.reason: NIST's official publication record establishes the precise date, April 3, 2025.
29.zh: NIST 於 2025 年 4 月 3 日發布 SP 800-61 Revision 3，取代 Revision 2。新版把事件應變整合到 NIST Cybersecurity Framework（CSF）2.0 的 Govern、Identify、Protect、Detect、Respond、Recover 六大功能，將應變能力納入持續的風險管理。
29.en: NIST published SP 800-61 Revision 3 on April 3, 2025, superseding Revision 2. It integrates incident response across the six NIST CSF 2.0 functions—Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond and Recover—as an ongoing risk-management capability.

71.en: MITRE ATT&CK T1078 — Valid Accounts describes adversarial abuse of valid accounts. At review, its current tactics include Initial Access, Persistence, Privilege Escalation and Stealth; valid accounts can also help activity blend into normal usage patterns.

117.reason: Separate the 2020 NICE Framework structure from the separately maintained Work Role components and current role names.
117.zh: NIST SP 800-181 Rev. 1（2020）提供 NICE Framework 的結構，重視實際工作任務、知識與技能。Work Roles 等元件另行維護；查核時的 Components v2.2.0（2026 年 4 月 28 日）區分 Defensive Cybersecurity、Incident Response、Threat Analysis 等角色。這些角色名稱應歸屬元件目錄，不能全部當成 2020 年文件中的原始職稱。
117.en: NIST SP 800-181 Rev. 1 (2020) defines the NICE Framework's structure around tasks, knowledge and skills. Work Roles and other components are maintained separately. At review, Components v2.2.0 (April 28, 2026) distinguishes roles such as Defensive Cybersecurity, Incident Response and Threat Analysis. These names belong to the component catalog and should not all be attributed as original job titles in the 2020 publication.

146.reason: Correct the false-positive-rate denominator; the proportion of alerts that are false is a different metric. Preserve all five operational metrics and their limits.
146.zh:
| 指標 | 英文 | 衡量問題 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MTTD | Mean Time to Detect | 從定義的事件起點到偵測，平均需要多久？ |
| MTTA | Mean Time to Acknowledge | 告警出現後，多久有人確認接手？ |
| MTTR | Mean Time to Respond / Recover 等 | 依明確定義衡量回應、修復或恢復時間。 |
| 誤報率（FPR） | False Positive Rate | FP/(FP+TN)：實際為陰性的觀測中，被誤判為陽性的比例。FP 是誤報，TN 是正確陰性；告警中的誤報比例另為 FP/(TP+FP)，其中 TP 是正確陽性，兩個分母不可混用。 |
| Escalation Quality | 升級品質 | 被升級的案件是否具有足夠證據與正確優先順序？ |
146.en:
| Metric | English | Measurement question |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MTTD | Mean Time to Detect | What is the average time from the defined event start to detection? |
| MTTA | Mean Time to Acknowledge | How long after an alert does someone acknowledge ownership? |
| MTTR | Mean Time to Respond / Recover, etc. | Measure response, repair or recovery using explicitly defined endpoints. |
| False-positive rate (FPR) | False Positive Rate | FP/(FP+TN): the proportion of actually negative observations incorrectly classified as positive. FP means false positive and TN true negative. The false-alert proportion is instead FP/(TP+FP), where TP means true positive; the denominators are not interchangeable. |
| Escalation Quality | Quality of escalation | Do escalated cases contain sufficient evidence and the correct priority? |

309.reason: Limit reporting immunity to the conditions and liability specified in 18 U.S.C. 1833(b)(1), preserving the unlawful-access limit in (b)(5), as confirmed in the official House US Code through Public Law 119-124 (2026-10-15); the GovInfo edition independently corroborates the provisions.
309.zh: 18 U.S.C. §1833(b) 對特定保密揭露提供美國聯邦及州營業秘密法下的民事與刑事責任免責：向美國聯邦、州或地方政府官員，或向律師保密揭露，且僅為通報或調查疑似違法行為。這不是所有揭露行為的概括免責；§1833(b)(5) 也不授權以其他違法方式取得營業秘密。
309.en: 18 U.S.C. §1833(b) provides immunity from civil and criminal liability under US federal and state trade-secret law for qualifying confidential disclosures to a US federal, state or local government official, or to an attorney, solely to report or investigate a suspected legal violation. This is not blanket immunity for every disclosure; §1833(b)(5) also does not authorize otherwise unlawful access to obtain trade secrets.

384.reason: Separate Article 55 commencement from Article 54 transitional adjustment requirements for specified institutions and provisions; effective provisions can still have a compliance transition period.
384.zh: 上述依據來自金管會官方法規系統。2026 年 5 月 6 日修正版本依第 55 條自發布日施行，僅第 44–47 條的施行日期由主管機關另定；表列的第 9、12、24、25 條不屬該另定日期範圍。另依第 54 條，金融控股公司及銀行業不符該條列舉的制度要求者，應於 2027 年 12 月 31 日前調整至符合規定；涉及的條款包括第 9 條、第 12 條第 1 項第 2 款第 13 目（營運持續管理機制）、第 24、25 條等，限於第 54 條所列的制度事項。該條另對信用合作社內部稽核報告永續資訊管理揭露要求設有同日調整期限。施行日期與特定調整期限應分開核對，不能因條文已施行就推論所有機構均無過渡安排。實際查核仍須確認行為時的適用版本、機構及要求。
384.en: These provisions come from the official FSC legal system. Under Article 55, the May 6, 2026 amendment took effect on publication, with commencement of Articles 44–47 separately determined by the competent authority; the table's Articles 9, 12, 24 and 25 are outside that deferred group. Separately, Article 54 requires financial holding companies and banking enterprises that do not meet its listed institutional requirements to adjust by December 31, 2027. The covered provisions include Article 9, Article 12 paragraph 1 subparagraph 2 item 13 (business continuity management), and Articles 24 and 25, among others, for the institutional matters specified in Article 54. It also gives credit cooperatives the same adjustment deadline for the specified sustainability-information disclosure in internal audit reports. Commencement and specific adjustment deadlines require separate checks: a provision being in force does not establish that every institution lacks a transition arrangement. Actual review must use the applicable version, institution and requirement at the time of conduct.
